restitution: Yes, that is the piece: the e-bike is now the deadliest way to cycle in Germany. The data is Destatis table 46241-11, people killed by mode of travel, 1979 to 2025.
takeaway: In 2025, one in six (16.4%) of the people killed on German roads was travelling by bicycle, and the rise since 2015 comes entirely from pedelecs: 214 pedelec riders were killed in 2025 against 36 in 2015.
claim: It is a comparison, about the column Getoetete_Pedelecs_ab_2014: 2025 against 2015, 2025 greater.
subject: People killed while riding a pedelec (pedal-assist e-bike) in Germany.
comparison: Riders of bicycles without a motor, over the same years — the series the pedelec was split out of in 2014.
limits: The table counts deaths, not risk: nothing records how many kilometres are ridden on a pedelec, so a rising toll is not a rising danger per kilometre. The two bicycle columns exist only from 2014. The 16.4% is the April 2026 preliminary figure; the July table gives 462 of 2 832, which is 16.3%.
placement: After the paragraph that says the increase is due to pedelec riders.
credit: Source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), table 46241-11, as of 7 July 2026.
